name: Feed2toot
tagline: Automatically parses rss feeds, identifies new posts and posts them on the Mastodon social network.
description: Feed2toot automatically parses rss feeds, identifies new posts and posts them on the Mastodon social network.
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/feed2toot:0.17.20251115@sha256:59e3ea300189052aba25c527a3501ade5c3a57466761c8a1e0ab1c8bdf90170d
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      FEED_LIMIT: ''
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
